chapter.heading: 2 Samuel 22
David’s Song of Deliverance
chapter.v: And David spoketo the Lord the words of this song on the day when the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies , and from the hand of Saul .
“ The Lord is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer ,
my savior ; you save me from violence .
and I am saved from my enemies .
the torrents of destruction assailed me ;
the snares of death confronted me .
and my crycame to his ears .
and quaked , because he was angry .
glowing coals flamed forth from him .
thick darkness was under his feet .
he was seen onthe wings of the wind .
thick clouds , a gathering of water .
coals of fire flamed forth .
and the Most High uttered his voice .
lightning , and routed them .
at theblast of the breath of his nostrils .
he drew me out of many waters .
for they were too mighty for me .
but the Lord was my support .
he rescued me , becausehe delighted in me .
according to thecleanness of my hands he rewarded me .
and have not wickedly departed from my God .
and from his statutes I did not turn aside .
and I kept myself from guilt .
according to my cleanness in his sight .
with theblameless man you show yourself blameless ;
and with the crooked you make yourself seem tortuous .
but your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down .
and my God lightens my darkness .
and by my God I can leap over a wall .
he isa shield for all those who take refuge in him .
And who is a rock , except our God ?
and has made my way blameless .
and set me secureon the heights .
so that my arms can bend a bow of bronze .
and your gentleness made me great .
and my feet did not slip ;
and did not turn back until they were consumed .
they fellunder my feet .
you madethose who rise against me sink under me .
those who hated me , and I destroyed them .
they cried to the Lord , buthe did not answer them .
I crushed them and stamped them downlike the mire of the streets .
people whom I had not known served me .
as soon as they heard of me , they obeyed me .
and came tremblingout of their fortresses .
and exalted bemy God ,the rock of my salvation ,
andbrought down peoples under me ,
you delivered me frommen of violence .
and sing praises to your name .
to David and his offspringforever . ”

22:41 Or *You gave me my enemies’ necks*
